decision.next: Freeze a bounded grouped flexible-versus-shallow development modeling contract on supported existing outcomes; do not fit during P3a. Preserve fixed-stop costs as proxies. Require targeted native qualification/timing only for a justified new policy or unsupported information/action/cost scope.
decision.supported_scope: Static23 versus progress34, original execution, current e7dc binary and fixed index, 200 exposed vectors, eight ordinal stop checkpoints plus continue. Outcomes complete wherever reached; use grouped adaptive-development evaluation only.
unsupported_without_new_measurement: Arbitrary checkpoint stops outside the eight-point grid
Complete light19 quality/cost matrix on the current binary across 200 vectors
End-to-end latency of any newly fitted policy or new model/feature/observation path
